target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
mkdir -p /tmp/probe
for LR in "24 4" "48 6" "96 12" "24 2" "64 8"; do
  set -- $LR; L=$1; R=$2
  ./collatz_tests spectral-gaps --moduli 27 --tilts 0 --L $L --R $R --bmax 20 --char-cap 0 --output-dir /tmp/probe >/dev/null 2>&1
  # quadratic char for Q=27 is k=9 (phi/2); print its gap_ratio_units (col17)
  val=$(grep -v '^#' /tmp/probe/spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$7==9{print $17}')
  rho=$(grep -v '^#' /tmp/probe/spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$7==9{print $8}')
  printf "L=%-3s R=%-3s : quadratic-char gap_ratio_units=%s (rho=%s)\n" "$L" "$R" "$val" "$rho"
done
